observations: Photo 0 shows four alternators lying on a concrete surface, with visible wear, dirt, and some corrosion. One has a black rubber boot on the pulley shaft, another has exposed wiring with red and yellow wires, and one has a small white sticker.
Photo 1 shows two alternators from the top view, both with pink paint marks on the housing. One has a black electrical connector with a visible 'F' marking.

Photo 2 shows two alternators from the front, focusing on the pulley and shaft. One has a black pulley with a visible bolt, the other has a pulley with a yellowish coating and a pink mark on the shaft.
All alternators appear to be used, with varying degrees of surface rust and grime. No brand or model markings are visible on any of the units.
The seller's text claims 'Alternator 1zz corolla, matrix 2002-2006', but no such text is visible on the alternators themselves.

claims.evidence: No visible markings on the alternators in any photo confirm the 1ZZ engine or Corolla/Matrix model compatibility. The seller's text is not verifiable from the images.

risks.risk: The alternator may not be compatible with the specified vehicle (Corolla/Matrix 2002-2006 1ZZ engine).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the alternator's part number or a label showing the OEM or compatible vehicle model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used alternator without model-specific value.

risks.risk: The alternator may be non-functional or have internal damage (e.g., worn brushes, damaged rotor/stator).
risks.proof: A video showing the alternator spinning freely and a multimeter test for output voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The alternator may have hidden corrosion or damage to the internal components not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A disassembled view or a close-up of the internal windings and brushes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a lower value due to potential internal damage.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the part number or label on the alternator.
A video showing the alternator spinning freely and a multimeter test for output.
A close-up of the internal components if possible.
response.reason: The alternators cannot be identified by model or brand from the photos, and the seller's claim of compatibility with 1ZZ Corolla/Matrix 2002-2006 is unverifiable. Functionality and compatibility are critical for pricing, and without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately.
